gaps.explanation: Schedule is 29,727 above the statement (10,939,542 vs 10,909,815). The budgetary comparison schedules count sale of assets inside 'Local' receipts, while the governmental funds statement (p5, General Fund and Road Fund columns) prints it separately under Other Financing Sources as 'Sale of assets' 29,637 + 90 = 29,727 (Total column 29,727, p6). General Fund budget schedule p10 Local 1,034,701 = statement/combining Local 1,005,064 (p5, p7) + sale of assets 29,637; Road Fund budget schedule p11 Local 444,303 = statement Local 444,213 (p5) + sale of assets 90. 29,637 + 90 = 29,727 = the gap. Both totals are printed as such (statement Total receipts 10,909,815 p6; General Fund budget Total receipts 7,067,257 p10, Road 2,098,043 p11), so no detail fix.

Schedule 3,339,755 vs statement 2,723,282 (schedule above by 616,473). The General Fund budget schedule (p10) and the General Fund combining statement (p7) print the General Fund sub-fund 'Transfers - in' 616,473 (from the Inheritance Tax Fund, which is combined into the General Fund on the statement). The governmental funds statement General Fund column (p5) prints Transfers - in 0 and Transfers - out (2,723,282), i.e. the 616,473 between the General Fund and its Inheritance Tax sub-fund is eliminated (combining p7: Total General Fund Transfers - in 616,473, Transfers - out (3,339,755), net (2,723,282)). Detail transfers in = 616,473 (General) + 2,672,322 (Road, p11) + 50,960 (Health Department, p8) = 3,339,755; statement Total 2,723,282 (p6) = 2,672,322 + 50,960. Difference 616,473 is the gross vs net presentation of the intra-General Fund transfer; no detail fix.

Schedule 3,339,755 vs statement 2,723,282 (schedule above by 616,473). Detail transfers out = General Fund (2,087,766) (budget schedule p10) + Inheritance Tax Fund (1,251,989) (combining p7) = 3,339,755, matching the combining statement's Total General Fund Transfers - out (3,339,755) (p7). The governmental funds statement General Fund column (p5) prints Transfers - out (2,723,282) = 3,339,755 - 616,473, because the 616,473 transferred from the Inheritance Tax sub-fund to the General Fund sub-fund is eliminated within the General Fund column. Gross vs net presentation of the same intra-fund transfer; no detail fix.
